note: The key-listener ratchet (owner, 2026-11-02: keys must be one reused component): every keydown or keyup listener added outside src/js/ui/keys/ (addEventListener('keydown'|'keyup'), onkeydown/onkeyup, and Alpine @keydown/@keyup in src/index.html), counted per file. The tree may hold at most these counts; a file not listed may hold none; a count only falls, and a file that reaches 0 loses its entry. New keys bind through src/js/ui/keys/registry.js (bind) and its one dispatcher.
